nodes.label: Shareholder letter
nodes.description: A narrative letter from the chairman or CEO to shareholders that reviews the year and outlook, as opposed to the formal Business or MD&A sections.

nodes.label: Business overview
nodes.description: A description of what the company does, its products, markets, competition, customers, and strategy (Form 10-K Item 1).

nodes.label: Risk factors
nodes.description: A discussion of the risks and uncertainties that could materially harm the business or the value of its securities (Item 1A).

nodes.label: Management discussion and analysis
nodes.description: Management's narrative explanation of results of operations, liquidity, capital resources, and trends, including market-risk disclosures (MD&A, Items 7 and 7A).

nodes.label: Financial statements
nodes.description: The primary statements themselves (balance sheet, income statement, cash flows, changes in equity) and the auditor's report on them, not the accompanying notes.

nodes.label: Notes to financial statements
nodes.description: The numbered explanatory notes on accounting policies, estimates, and line-item detail that accompany and support the financial statements.

nodes.label: Corporate governance
nodes.description: Information about the board of directors, its committees, director independence, officers, and governance practices and policies.

nodes.label: Executive compensation
nodes.description: Disclosure of pay for senior executives and directors, including salary, bonuses, equity awards, and pay-versus-performance tables.

nodes.label: Controls and procedures
nodes.description: Management's evaluation of disclosure controls and internal control over financial reporting, including any material weaknesses (Item 9A).

nodes.label: Legal proceedings
nodes.description: A description of pending or threatened litigation, regulatory actions, and other legal matters involving the company (Item 3).

nodes.label: Properties
nodes.description: A description of the company's principal physical facilities, such as plants, offices, and real estate it owns or leases (Item 2).

nodes.label: Market for equity
nodes.description: Information on the market for the company's common stock, including listing, holders, dividends, share repurchases, and stock performance (Item 5).

nodes.label: Exhibits
nodes.description: The list of exhibits and filed documents, signatures, and schedules incorporated by reference, which carries no narrative content of its own (Item 15).

nodes.label: Sustainability
nodes.description: Material on environmental and social topics such as climate commitments, emissions, workforce, and community impact; it excludes board and corporate governance, which belongs to corporate_governance.

nodes.label: Other
nodes.description: Content that fits none of the other categories, such as cover pages, tables of contents, forward-looking-statement legends, and miscellaneous disclosures.
